replies.author: Tazz
replies.body:
pls not ghost squadron

if gamemodes can't get advertised correctly, nothing will change. It's as simple as that. SkyWars, a fail from what i've heard. It has 2 players on right now lol. If you're going to add new gamemodes, then they need to be advertised. Why should I play Sky Wars on Avicus, a server with 30 players, when I go and play it on Hypixel, a server with like 20k players?

It's a terrible boring gamemode, at least Sky Wars can be fun.

Existing gamemodes should be improved, for example CTW is complete shit right now.
